### 2026-10-09 – # Beginning PCB of Starbie:

**1.5h**

# Beginning PCB of Starbie:

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 114352](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0aarGbJccoUMlYsdnsqaFbGyjX0xwdlM/29623e86ec2592715463364cc602f5c5573764979de50667644fe289f63728f4.png)

For the first few mins, I was setting up the files for the project and getting all the necessary stuff down. Then, I was experimenting around with KiCAD to see how it works.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0aarGbJccoUMlYsdnsqaFbGyjX0xwdlM/638d861269ed0cd6c2d638f23fc90b62ccba92426eb4a137003d1bf9d2c41a7a.png)

Later, I was looking at the tutorial for "How to make your own Starbie". I downloaded the KiCad program and followed the instructions. Throughout the way, I ended not understanding the purpose of each document, so I would search online and see what it is and what it is used for.

### 2026-10-10 – # Finalizing Starry

**4h**

# Finalizing Starry
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0aarGbJccoUMlYsdnsqaFbGyjX0xwdlM/173ba4e08e4d471d668fb3ade140be1833baec57a6628eff18420374c492f9c1.png)

For this session, I worked on Starry. I focused mainly on KiCad, getting the board wired correctly, cleaning up traces, and learning more about how the PCB tools work.

At the start, I was setting up all the project files and organizing the folders I needed.  I played around with the schematic editor, checked how footprints link to symbols, and explored the PCB layout view.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0aarGbJccoUMlYsdnsqaFbGyjX0xwdlM/b2fc292a4e60c295c0ccf5aee0619340b3c5302474ea7628bc4eb5fe89e53d55.png)

Making sure the wire works took some time, but I made a lot of progress, and the board is starting to look clean and functional.

Once the PCB was in a good place, I started working on a case for Starry. I measured the board, planned where the screen window would go, and began shaping the outer shell.

I also ended up trying out the simulation and looked over the code.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0aarGbJccoUMlYsdnsqaFbGyjX0xwdlM/1ad17554123c3b65c004d86ecb04ee3b2f026365fdf91f821fc1ca19d053665d.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0aarGbJccoUMlYsdnsqaFbGyjX0xwdlM/03972b8686a9834a5b0228cbd37a5b7ff8225a721adcb07272dea253ff351bff.png)

Planning a New Project
Toward the end of the session, I started brainstorming a completely new idea:
a voice‑controlled MP3 player necklace that responds using AI.
This is still in the planning stage
